title: PageTabs
description: A strip of open application pages (route navigation, not an ARIA tablist): the application owns routes, closing and unsaved-change guards. Items are flat rounded surfaces; long titles are truncated and shown in full in a tooltip; the current page stays in view and scroll buttons appear when the list overflows.

support.notes: Page-tab onSelect/actions/close events, measured overflow arrows and active-item native scrollIntoView; step selection, active-path tree expansion with explicit collapse persistence and renderLink(item,content,state). Native touch/view semantics differ from browser DOM semantics. Native devices do not expose document focus, inert, browser portals or File input APIs; H5 capabilities are specified separately. Device-runtime validation is still required. Native horizontal scrolling and touch activation replace browser keyboard navigation. Native route links require the application renderer or onItemSelect to navigate. PageTabs uses native scroll measurement and explicit dir for RTL; React has no reorder API, and child order follows the caller. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official Taro WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

translationResources.title: PageTabs
translationResources.description: A strip of open application pages (route navigation, not an ARIA tablist): the application owns routes, closing and unsaved-change guards. Items are flat rounded surfaces; long titles are truncated and shown in full in a tooltip; the current page stays in view and scroll buttons appear when the list overflows.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Each PageTab has a label button (aria-current="page" when active) and an optional separate action such as a close button. When the focused item is closed, focus moves to the current page.

context-menu.title: Context menu and actions
context-menu.description: Wrap items in a ContextMenu for per-page commands; actions renders global controls outside the scrolling list.

overflow.title: Overflow and disabled
overflow.description: When the pages overflow, scroll buttons appear and the active page is scrolled into view. Disabled pages cannot be selected and show no tooltip.

PageTabsProps.aria-label: Accessible label of the navigation landmark (e.g. "Open pages")
PageTabsProps.activeValue: Value of the current route's item. When it (or the set of items) changes, the active item is scrolled into view
PageTabsProps.actions: Global actions shown after the scrollable list (e.g. a page menu)
PageTabsProps.scrollLeftLabel: Accessible label of the "scroll left" button
PageTabsProps.scrollRightLabel: Accessible label of the "scroll right" button

PageTabProps.ref: Ref to the item wrapper element
PageTabProps.value: Identifier of the page (exposed as data-value)
PageTabProps.label: Title of the page; truncated with an ellipsis, shown in full in a tooltip
PageTabProps.active: Marks the item as the current page (aria-current="page")
PageTabProps.disabled: Disables the label button (the separate action keeps its own state)
PageTabProps.action: Separate control rendered next to the label (e.g. a close IconButton)
PageTabProps.onSelect: Called when the label button is activated

cssVars.--page-tabs-item-max-width: Maximum width of a tab (the label truncates)
cssVars.--page-tabs-item-radius: Corner radius of a tab (defaults to --radius-lg)

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: active-value marks the current page and follows minerva-select. closable adds a close button that fires minerva-close: remove the element to close the page. The icon slot holds an icon before the label.

actions.title: Actions
actions.description: The actions slot renders global controls outside the scrolling list (here, a button that opens a new page); the action slot of an item holds its own separate control, such as a pin toggle.

overflow.title: Overflow and disabled
overflow.description: When the pages overflow, scroll buttons appear (scroll-left-label / scroll-right-label name them) and the active page is scrolled into view. Disabled pages cannot be selected.

events.minerva-select: Bubbles from a <minerva-page-tab>: a page was chosen (detail: { value }).
events.minerva-close: Bubbles from a <minerva-page-tab>: the close button of a page was activated (detail: { value }).

slots.actions: Global actions after the scrollable list (e.g. a page menu).

cssVars.--icon-button-color: Icon color of the close / scroll buttons.
cssVars.--icon-button-hover-bg: Background of the close / scroll buttons on hover.
cssVars.--icon-button-pressed-color: Icon color of a pressed toggle.
cssVars.--icon-button-size: Width and height of the close / scroll buttons.
cssVars.--icon-button-radius: Corner radius of the square shape (defaults to --radius-lg).

props.closable: Renders a built-in close button that fires minerva-close.
props.closeLabel: Accessible label of the close button (default: localized "Close <label>").

events.minerva-select: The label button was activated (detail: { value }). Cancelable: preventDefault() keeps the strip's active-value.
events.minerva-close: The built-in close button was activated (detail: { value }); remove the element to close the page.

slots.action: Separate control next to the label (e.g. a close or pin button).

cssVars.--icon-button-color: Icon color of the close / scroll buttons.
cssVars.--icon-button-hover-bg: Background of the close / scroll buttons on hover.
cssVars.--icon-button-pressed-color: Icon color of a pressed toggle.
cssVars.--icon-button-size: Width and height of the close / scroll buttons.
cssVars.--icon-button-radius: Corner radius of the square shape (defaults to --radius-lg).
